rows.text: for `esi` = 0 to 3 calls the function at `00311E90` + 0x2A with `ecx` = `esi` and skips that index when the result `P` or qword `P+0x698` (`Q`) is null, or when dword `Q+0x64` OR dword `Q+0x3C` has any bit of `0x80000003` set and the call at `00311E90` + 0x51 (with `ecx` = that OR) returns 0; every other `P` is stored to the next qword of `022C1788` (only while fewer than 4 are stored) and counted; then ORs `0x600` into dword `+4` of each non-null qword among the first count entries of `022C1788`

with `n` = word `rcx+0x28` sign-extended, scans k = 1 up to `n`-1 (signed) at stride 0xA0 for the first k whose byte `rcx+0xC5+k*0xA0` equals 1 and returns float dword `rcx+0x3C+k*0xA0` in `xmm0`; returns 0.0 when no k matches or `n` is at most 1
